evidence.quoted_text:
"manager_restarted": (
            (((manager.get("before") or {}).get("manager") or {})
             .get("pid") or 0) > 0
            and (((manager.get("after") or {}).get("manager") or {})
                 .get("pid") or 0) > 0
            and (manager.get("before") or {}).get("manager", {}).get("pid")
            != (manager.get("after") or {}).get("manager", {}).get("pid")
            and bool(((manager.get("before") or {}).get("manager") or {})
                     .get("invocation_id"))
            and bool(((manager.get("after") or {}).get("manager") or {})
                     .get("invocation_id"))
            and (manager.get("before") or {}).get("manager", {}).get("invocation_id")
            != (manager.get("after") or {}).get("manager", {}).get("invocation_id")),
evidence.reason: The `manager_restarted` evidence only requires changed, nonempty manager PIDs and invocation IDs on both sides. A guest reboot between those observations changes both fields, so it can satisfy this check even though the manager was not restarted; the separate `boot_id_changed` check only covers the reboot phase and does not constrain the manager-restart interval. Requiring nonempty equal guest boot IDs across the manager before/after observations is a small correctness fix to existing evidence, not a new requirement or an owner-level behavior change.
